subject: Note-decay: recall-outcome consumer + age-gated soft-retire lane in the judge
description:
Build the note-decay (necessity) lane. Forks off orch/feature/note-decay.

SCOPE:
1. Usage aggregator (new pure lib, e.g. lib/note-necessity.js): read RESOLVED rows from .graph/recall-outcome-journal.jsonl (lib/recall-outcome-journal.js readRows/latestByTask) + overlay note_nodes → per-note { recallCount, winCount (approve/tested), lossCount (kickback/failed), opportunities, lastRecalledAt }.
2. Age/opportunity-gated necessity scorer: classify each CURRENT note as keep | retire-candidate (dead weight: never recalled in >=k opportunities, OR recalled only into losers) | stale (cited file/commit moved) | subsumed (defer to existing dup-cluster, just flag). GATE: only emit retire-candidate after k opportunities OR d days — NEVER eager-on-add. Pure + unit-tested.
3. Judge slow-lane: extend lib/judge.js buildQueue with a 'necessity' work-item kind (slow lane; NOT in the eager path C). Verdict = SOFT-RETIRE only: append note_superseded with validTo set + NO supersededBy (reuse the exact primitive documented in scripts/retire-continuity-notes.js); journal via judge appendVerdict. NO hard delete.
4. Safety rails: auto-retire only HIGH-confidence; surface borderline to guidance (request_guidance/guidance item); user-veto affordance mirroring overlay.distinctClusters ('do not retire again'). Update skills/self-learn-edge-judge/SKILL.md for the retire verdict.
5. Tests across (unit for scorer, integration for the judge lane + soft-retire round-trip + temporal recoverability via history/as_of).

CONTEXT: recall-outcome-journal is currently WRITE-ONLY (recorded at search + task-terminal, never read back for lifecycle). The soft-retire primitive already exists (note_superseded w/o successor drops a note from search_knowledge/RAG/judge passes but keeps it as recoverable bitemporal history). This task wires the unused signal to the existing primitive behind a new gated lane.

Worker: branch_task base=orch/feature/note-decay; commit all changes onto orch/attempt/<key> BEFORE complete_task.
